trace_summary.task_objective: A fixed three-hop retrieval pipeline over Wikipedia abstracts. It performs exactly three retrievals and returns the concatenation of everything retrieved. The program has no verification stage, no completeness check, no early-exit condition, no deduplication, and no relevance filter.
trace_summary.final_output_summary: 24 documents returned across three hops. Hop 1 retrieved 7 documents including key documents about Marali Mannige (novel by K. Shivaram Karanth) and Yakshagana (traditional theatre form). Hop 2 retrieved 7 documents including K. Shivaram Karanth's biography confirming he was a Yakshagana artist. Hop 3 retrieved 10 documents. All three hops completed as specified.
trace_summary.summary: The three-hop retrieval pipeline executed all seven specified steps successfully. Hop 1 retrieved documents defining Yakshagana and identifying K. Shivaram Karanth as the author of Marali Mannige. The summarizer correctly identified that K. Shivaram Karanth's connection to Yakshagana was missing from hop 1 passages. Hop 2's query generator produced a comprehensive biographical query, and retrieval returned a document explicitly stating K. Shivaram Karanth was a Yakshagana artist. The hop 2 summarizer correctly identified this information and noted only the publication date remained unverified. Hop 3's query targeted the remaining gap. All 24 documents were concatenated and returned as specified. The pipeline completed its structural obligations: three retrievals executed, four generated steps produced valid outputs, and final assembly concatenated all results.
